blocks.goal: No safe, API-preserving modularization change can be applied: the target is a public interface whose members (nested interfaces, enums, and methods) are part of the public API. Moving or extracting those public members would change FQNs or require call-site updates. Therefore emit NO_OP.

ops.details: The Connection type is a public interface exposing many nested public types and public methods. Any extraction or movement of these public members would change the public API (FQNs or require call-site changes). To preserve API and tests, no safe refactoring is performed.
